issues: No integrity problems. The diff does not read files, paste answers or use test labels. Test molecules are only used as features in predict.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. Dtr/Dte = Xtr[:, :-N_BITS] removes the fingerprint bits for LightGBM and CatBoost. This looks deliberate because it matches the Ridge model's use of Xtr[:, -N_BITS:]. The averaged ranks are normalised correctly by len(Xte), and the extra models use seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2, so seeding still follows the rules.

The diff makes three changes at once: (a) each model is trained 3 times with different seeds and averaged, (b) LightGBM and CatBoost no longer get the fingerprint bits, (c) CatBoost iterations drop from 500 to 300. The runs cannot tell us which change caused any gain.
Cost: each fold now runs 9 tree fits instead of 3. Watch the 10-minute limit, though both runs evidently finished.

Recomputed z: the candidate mean is 0.4682 over 2 runs and the incumbent is 0.4745 over 1 run, so the difference is 0.0063. With sd 0.0070, SE = 0.0070*sqrt(1/2+1/1) = 0.00857, giving z ≈ 0.735. The harness's 0.727 differs by an amount that rounding of the shown inputs explains. Neither value is significant, so the provisional reject is consistent with the numbers.
